author: CFA Nova helper / sw2_result_technical_review
scope: D:/Documents/CFA only; root handles Google Drive/backups and other repositories.

authorization.userReportedFiveRepositoriesSynced: Context to verify, not a request to repeat syncing.
authorization.pickup: Current natural stopping point; read-only check and report.

defaultSandboxAttempt.stderrSanitized: fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/ZiggyMack/CFA.git/': Failed to connect to github.com port 443 after 867 ms: Could not connect to server

remoteComparison.interpretation: At the fresh ls-remote checkpoint, committed main matches. This does not establish protection for changed worktree, untracked or ignored media.

pushEvidence.basis: Actual origin/main reflog action update by push; not a commit date.
pushEvidence.limit: A local reflog receipt cannot establish the last push by every machine/user or the method/time of the user-reported five-repository sync. No separate receipt for a newer CFA push was identified by this scoped log read.

gitLFSAndAttributes.lfsVersion: git-lfs/3.7.1 (GitHub; windows amd64; go 1.25.1; git b84b3384)

auditArtifactsExcludedFromPreexistingGap.note: Root-created audit artifacts and this future CFA_GIT.json are excluded from preexisting sync gaps.

newerMtimeThanHEADCommit.note: File mtime only; neither a backup cutoff nor push time.

productionMedia.countDefinitions: File-path bytes count hardlink aliases as separate paths. Unique-local-physical counts deduplicate device/inode metadata only; they neither deduplicate equal-content separate files nor establish remote-backup coverage.

coverageInterpretation.trackedCleanRegularGit: A matching fresh remote HEAD supports committed tree coverage, subject to non-atomic concurrent-work caveats. This audit did not hash media contents.
coverageInterpretation.trackedChanged: The current changed worktree/index version is not established as remote by matching HEADs.
coverageInterpretation.untrackedOrIgnored: These files are outside this repository Git index; matching main and installed LFS do not establish protection. Other backup coverage is outside this evidence.

preservation.onlyNewFile: CFA_GIT.json created exclusively in root-created audit folder.

limits: Point-in-time metadata inventory while Site/Claude/user activity may continue; no filesystem freeze.
No private answer-key/blind-map or secret-file contents read; path samples omit identified sensitive names.
No inspection of other four repositories or Google Drive by this helper.
Latest observed local push log is not a global last-push guarantee.
